sloka: वैदेहीं प्रार्थयानं तं विराधं प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसम्।हतमेकेन रामेण पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम् ।। ६.९५.१३ ।।
transliteration: vaidehīṁ prārthayānaṁ taṁ virādhaṁ prekṣya rākṣasam।hatamekena rāmeṇa paryāptaṁ tannidarśanam ।। 6.95.13 ।।

translations.english: "Hope the ten headed Ravana will not touch Sita forcibly, by which undying enmity has been contracted already."
